info.title: Tokenized assets API
info.description:
Public, read-only API over tokenized asset data, updated daily. No key is needed. Requests are rate limited per IP address.

## Three endpoints

| Endpoint | Returns |
|---|---|
| `/assets` | All active assets, one row each |
| `/assets/catalog` | Everything you can request: metrics, groups, categories, fields and filter values |
| `/assets/{slug}` | One asset, plus any sections you ask for |

## Ask only for what you need

With no parameters, `/assets/{slug}` returns the core: identity, issuer, organizations, networks and five key metrics. Add sections with `include`, and only those are queried.

| Section | Contents | Narrow with |
|---|---|---|
| `financials` | Each metric's value, label, group, unit, scope, date and past values | `groups`, `financialMetrics` |
| `series` | Which history series this asset has | |
| `valueByNetwork` | Value and share per network | |
| `terms` | Fund terms and fees | |
| `fields` | Descriptive values by category, with coverage | `categories`, `empty` |
| `tokens` | One row per token | `network` |

Daily points are requested by name: `history` takes metric names, and `range` sets how far back they go, 3 months by default.

## Examples

| You want | Call |
|---|---|
| Stablecoins by size | `/assets?assetType=stablecoin&sort=-total_asset_value_dollar` |
| Every asset compared on one metric | `/assets?metrics=market_value_dollar&sort=-market_value_dollar&limit=200` |
| The basics for one asset | `/assets/usdt` |
| Everything on an asset page | `/assets/usdt?include=fields,tokens` |
| Only issuer and legal facts that have a value | `/assets/usdt?include=fields&categories=issuer,legal&empty=false` |
| The financials tab | `/assets/usdt?include=financials,series,valueByNetwork,terms` |
| Value and yield numbers only | `/assets/usdt?include=financials&groups=value,yield` |
| One metric with its past values | `/assets/usdt?include=financials&financialMetrics=price_dollar` |
| Price history only | `/assets/usdt?history=price_dollar&range=1y` |
| Two series on one chart | `/assets/usdt?history=price_dollar,net_asset_value_dollar` |

## Rules

- **Lists** are comma-separated, with no spaces.
- **Names:** `metrics` is always a plain name-to-number map, and `financials` is always the full array with labels and past values.
- **Errors:** an unknown parameter or name is a 400, and so is a filter for a section you didn't ask for. An unknown asset is a 404. A valid metric with no data comes back as `null` or with empty points.
- **Holder shares:** `top_*_holder_concentration` always reads the Solana token, because the asset-level value adds up each token's percentage. A share above 100% can't be true, so it's `null`.
- **Caching:** responses carry an `ETag`. Send it back in `If-None-Match` to get a 304 when nothing has changed.

get.summary: Whether the database is reachable and the schema is new enough

get.description: Active assets, one row each, with the metrics you choose. To compare every asset on one metric, use `?metrics=market_value_dollar&sort=-market_value_dollar&limit=200`.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Only assets with an active token on this network

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated metric names for `metrics`. Defaults to the five key metrics: `price_dollar`, `net_asset_value_dollar`, `total_asset_value_dollar`, `apy_30_day` and `holding_addresses_count`. The catalog lists every name.

parameters.name: solanaMetrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated metric names to read from each asset's Solana token rather than the whole asset. They come back in `solanaMetrics`, which appears only when sent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `ticker` or a metric name. A leading `-` sorts descending. Missing values sort last, and ties break by slug.

metrics.description: Numbers by metric name. A metric with no value is `null`

solanaMetrics.description: Numbers by metric name. A metric with no value is `null`

304.description: The ETag matches, so there's no body

400.description: Invalid or unknown parameter or name

schema.description: Invalid or unknown parameter or name

get.description: With no parameters, returns the core: identity, issuer, organizations, networks and five key metrics. Add sections with `include`, and daily points with `history`. A section appears only if you asked for it, and a filter for a section you didn't ask for is a 400.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated sections to add to the core: `financials`, `series`, `valueByNetwork`, `terms`, `fields`, `tokens`. Only these are queried.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated metric names for `metrics`. Defaults to the five key metrics: `price_dollar`, `net_asset_value_dollar`, `total_asset_value_dollar`, `apy_30_day` and `holding_addresses_count`. The catalog lists every name.

parameters.name: financialMetrics
parameters.description: Narrows `financials` to these metric names. With `groups`, a metric must match both. Needs `include=financials`.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Narrows `fields` to these categories, such as `issuer,legal`. The catalog lists them. Needs `include=fields`.

parameters.name: empty
parameters.description: Defaults to `true`. Set to `false` to drop listed fields that have no value. Coverage counts don't change. Needs `include=fields`.

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: Comma-separated metric names to return daily points for, up to 10.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: How far back `history` goes, counted from each series' own last point. Defaults to `3m`. Needs `history`.

metrics.description: Numbers by metric name. A metric with no value is `null`

financials.description: Each metric's current value with its label, group, unit and past values

scope.description: `asset` is the whole asset across networks. `solana` is its Solana token only

series.description: The history series this asset has, without their points
